stem.text: The spring constants of four springs are determined by plotting the following graphs of force $F$ against extension $x$.

stem.alt: Graph 1: force F/N against extension x/mm, a straight line through the origin with axis marks at 10 N and 5 mm and dashed guide lines to the end of the line.
Graph 2: force F/N against extension x/mm, a straight line through the origin with axis marks at 20 N and 4 mm and dashed guide lines to the end of the line.
Graph 3: force F/N against extension x/mm, a straight line through the origin with axis marks at 100 N and 0.1 mm and dashed guide lines to the end of the line.
Graph 4: force F/N against extension x/mm, a straight line through the origin with axis marks at 10 N and 0.5 mm and dashed guide lines to the end of the line.

stem.text: Which order of the graphs shows **decreasing** spring constants?
